'''Moosh Kole''' was an individual who worked as a performer. When the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo family]] visited [[Oseon VII]] in [[43 ABY]], Moosh Kole was among the privates performers being hosted on Oseon VII, along with the [[Saffin Omlick Group]] and the [[Kinetic Krew]] of the [[Molpol's Traveling Circus]].<ref name="Millennium Falcon">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>
